item.title: Quest Global Is Said to Invite Banks to Pitch for $1 Billion IPO
item.description: Carlyle Group Inc.-backed Quest Global Services Pte has begun discussions with investment banks for a potential initial public offering in Mumbai that could raise as much as $1 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Saudi Aramco Unveils $3 Billion Buyback and Raises Dividend
item.description: Saudi Aramco approved a $3 billion share buyback program and raised its dividend payout, as it looks to shore up sentiment after the war in the Middle East hit the company’s operations.

item.title: Asian Buyers Struggle to Find March LNG as Supply Remains Tight
item.description: Some Asian LNG buyers are struggling to find prompt cargoes after a war-related outage at the world’s largest export facility in Qatar tightened global supplies of the super-chilled fuel.

item.title: Japan Confirms Economy Expanded as Takaichi Urges Investment
item.description: Japan’s economy expanded in the final quarter of 2025 more than initially reported thanks to stronger corporate investment, as Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urges further spending to develop key industries.

item.title: Bitcoin Steadies Around $70,000 as Iran War Worries Ease
item.description: Bitcoin reached $70,000 for the first time in four days as concerns over the war with Iran eased following comments from US President Donald Trump.

item.title: South Africa Targets Infrastructure Deals With Guarantee Fund
item.description: South Africa plans to rapidly expand a new credit-guarantee vehicle to support billions of dollars in infrastructure projects, from power-grid expansion and water systems to ports and freight rail.

item.title: Absa Profit Climbs to Fresh Record as Africa Businesses Expand
item.description: Absa Group Ltd.’s profit rose to a record as business outside the lender’s home market of South Africa surged.
